question: Should ClawSweeper use the public dashboard exact-review snapshot to cap broad review work at 16 workers when congested and 4 when saturated?
rationale: The thresholds and telemetry dependency determine production backlog allocation and cannot be validated as the intended operating policy from tests alone.

options.title: Trial the adaptive caps
options.body: Run a controlled live workflow trial, verify timely recovery to idle, and land the policy if the observed throughput tradeoff is acceptable.

options.title: Keep current allocation
options.body: Decline dashboard-driven throttling and retain the existing background worker calculation until a different priority mechanism is chosen.

recommendation.title: Trial the adaptive caps
recommendation.body: Run a controlled live workflow trial, verify timely recovery to idle, and land the policy if the observed throughput tradeoff is acceptable.

likelyOwner.reason: This is a repository-wide production scheduling and capacity-policy decision rather than a narrow implementation detail.
